body: Additional verified boundary from learningApproval.ts: fresh prepare enqueues only the new current operation, but explicit supersession of imported pending operations also updates/enqueues those old operation records (lines 76-82). Do not incorrectly claim prepare always dirties exactly one path. The saved whitelist remains only the current owned untracked operation; other dirty/staged records must fail closed and remain preserved. In the initially-clean fresh-card positive consumer there are no superseded records. Keep actionable diagnostics for other dirty files rather than silently broadening this ticket or suppressing flush. If a caller requires imported supersession on a checked-out root, it must satisfy the normal other-file clean precondition before a new prepare result can be accepted; never auto-commit/stash/reset, never treat imported records as execution authority.
